questionnaire_decision_scores.analysis: JAR packaging decision was correct and required no fixes. Standard Quarkus approach worked perfectly.

problems_encountered: Required switch to smallrye-reactive-messaging in build iteration 2
MDB conversion had to use @Incoming instead of JMS listeners
ShoppingCartOrderProcessor required Emitter pattern instead of JMS Producer

questionnaire_decision_scores.analysis: Artemis JMS decision proved problematic. Extension was incompatible with Quarkus 3.8.4, forcing migration to SmallRye Reactive Messaging. This required more significant code changes than anticipated for MDB migration.
questionnaire_decision_scores.alternative_recommendation: D002: Select 'quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging' from the start. This is the modern, recommended approach for Quarkus 3 and would have avoided compatibility issues and rework.

problems_encountered: JPA imports using javax instead of jakarta (build iteration 2)

questionnaire_decision_scores.analysis: Hibernate ORM decision was correct. The javax→jakarta import issue was a general Java EE→Jakarta EE migration concern, not specific to the Hibernate ORM choice. All entities worked without code changes beyond imports.

Keeping Flyway was the right choice. Quarkus Flyway extension worked seamlessly, existing migration scripts were preserved, and DataBaseMigrationStartup was cleanly replaced by Quarkus auto-migration.
RESTEasy Reactive worked perfectly. JAX-RS endpoints required no code changes beyond dependency updates. Clean phase completion.
ArC CDI worked well. The javax→jakarta import issue was not specific to ArC choice. All CDI patterns (@Inject, @Produces, @ApplicationScoped) worked correctly.
OIDC decision appears correct based on clean configuration phase. No build issues encountered. Runtime testing would confirm full integration.
Application.properties worked perfectly. Clean migration from XML configuration with no issues.
Java 17 upgrade from Java 8 was smooth. No compatibility issues encountered. Good balance of modern features and stability.
System-scoped dependency approach worked for migration. Noted as technical debt in known_limitations but didn't block progress.
Replacing WebLogic stubs with Quarkus lifecycle events was the correct approach. Clean removal of legacy code with proper modern equivalents.
Converting JSP to static SPA worked cleanly. Migration to META-INF/resources completed without issues.
JUnit 5 migration completed cleanly (Step 42). Tests not executed during migration but compilation successful. Modern testing stack in place.
Dev Services configuration added without issues. Will simplify local development once messaging configuration is completed.
Health and metrics endpoints configured successfully. Cloud-native observability foundation established.

decision_summary.key_insight: The messaging decision (D002) was the only significant misstep. Choosing quarkus-artemis-jms led to compatibility issues and forced a pivot to SmallRye Reactive Messaging during build gate fixes. All other decisions proved sound.

what_struggled.pattern: Messaging extension selection and MDB migration
what_struggled.details: Initial quarkus-artemis-jms choice was incompatible with Quarkus 3.8.4. Required switch to smallrye-reactive-messaging and conversion of MDBs to @Incoming pattern
errors: JMS classes missing in MDB implementations
what_struggled.recommendation: Research extension compatibility with target Quarkus version before selecting. SmallRye Reactive Messaging is the recommended modern approach for Quarkus 3.

what_struggled.details: Multiple iterations needed to catch all javax→jakarta import updates across different package hierarchies
errors: JPA imports using javax instead of jakarta (iteration 2)
what_struggled.recommendation: Automated import scanning/replacement in plan phase could catch these proactively. Consider using automated refactoring tools or OpenRewrite recipes for javax→jakarta migration.

common_error_patterns.error_example: Quarkus version 3.8.0 not found in Maven Central
common_error_patterns.prevention: Verify Quarkus version exists in Maven Central before use. Use version from official Quarkus documentation.
Check Quarkus extension compatibility matrix. Some extensions lag behind core Quarkus releases.

common_error_patterns.error_example: JPA imports using javax instead of jakarta
common_error_patterns.fix_applied: Systematic replacement of javax.persistence→jakarta.persistence, javax.enterprise→jakarta.enterprise, javax.xml.bind→jakarta.xml.bind
common_error_patterns.prevention: Use automated tools like OpenRewrite or IDE refactoring to handle namespace migration comprehensively in one pass.

common_error_patterns.error_example: Logger.warning() method not available in JBoss Logging
common_error_patterns.prevention: Document JBoss Logging API differences from java.util.logging. Include in migration patterns.

common_error_patterns.error_example: JMS classes missing in MDB implementations, ShoppingCartOrderProcessor using jakarta.jms classes
common_error_patterns.fix_applied: Converted to @Incoming for consumers, @Channel + Emitter for producers
common_error_patterns.prevention: Document SmallRye Reactive Messaging patterns clearly. Include MDB→@Incoming and JMS Producer→Emitter conversion examples.
